svg.title: Sequence Diagram
svg.desc: The sequence follows one new receiving request through the browser, inventory API and persistence boundary. The loop fragment represents the actual per-line validation, conversion and stock writes before the operation result and receipt commit together.
svg.text: UML sequence | successful new stock receiving request
load User for API access checks
create operation; lock items; create receipt
validate line; convert quantity; create batch
load receipt; save operation result; COMMIT
Alternatives: identical identity replays the saved result; changed identity returns 409; any write exception rolls back.
